content:
Maya: Quick catch-up on postmortem follow-ups for the metering outage that undercounted tokens and delayed usage. Need clear owners and timelines for: customer credits, ledger backfill, runbook updates, and recurrence alerts. Who can take what?

Raj: I can do the ledger backfill + validation. Will file FIN-412 and post validation query. Planning a small canary first. ETA: Tue EOD.

Zoe: I'll handle customer credits and invoice patches. Will coordinate with Finance Ops for audit trail. ETA: Wed 14:00.

Ben: I'll update runbooks and add a checklist for 'metering replayer' safe-run. Also will create a short runbook PR. Owner: Ben. ETA: Thu morning.

Aria: I'll own recurrence detection. Proposed alert: sum(consumer_lag) > 5m over 3m window -> page. Also add an automated replayer trigger to staging. ETA: Wed EOD.

billing-bot: Created ticket INV-440 for invoice corrections (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INV-440)

Raj: Validation query (will run against snapshots):

```
SELECT account_id, snapshot_ts, tokens_raw, tokens_corrected, (tokens_corrected - tokens_raw) as delta
FROM metering_snapshots
WHERE snapshot_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-12T23:59:59Z'
AND delta IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(delta) DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

Zoe: For credits, we'll produce negative-line invoice adjustments and a CSV export for CS. Ben, can you add a one-line note for customers?

Ben: Yep. Suggested language: "We identified and corrected a metering discrepancy that affected token counts between Mar 10-12; credits have been applied to affected invoices." Short + non-technical.

Maya: Good. Action summary:
- Ledger backfill + validation: Raj (FIN-412) — canary Tue, full run Wed morning
- Invoice corrections & customer CSV: Zoe (INV-440) — credits applied Wed 14:00
- Runbook + PR: Ben — Thu morning
- Recurrence alert + auto-replayer: Aria — Wed EOD

Maya: Please update the linked tickets and drop the credit CSV into /finance/credits/ for records. Reconvene Fri 09:00 PT to confirm closure.

Raj: noted, scheduling canary Tue 03:00 UTC and will ping ops-bot.

ops-bot: Canary window scheduled Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC. Reminder set 30m prior.

Zoe: I'll post the customer messaging draft here before sending.

Aria: I'll add alert runbook steps and link to FIN-412.

Maya: Thanks team ":thumbsup:"

Ben: ":+1:"
